title: feat: Route planner with green corridor AQI scoring
body:
## Summary

Add a complete **Delhi NCR route planner** with Amazon Location Service v2 integration and optional green-corridor AQI classification. This extends the environmental intelligence platform from "see the bad air" to "find a cleaner path."

## Features

### Route Planner Page (`/routes`)
- **Origin/destination selects** — 5 Delhi NCR locations (Noida Sector 62, Anand Vihar, Punjabi Bagh, Gurugram Sector 51, Central Delhi)
- **Swap button** — instant origin/destination toggle
- **Up to 3 route alternatives** — fetched from Amazon Location v2 API
- **Route cards** show:
  - Estimated time & distance
  - Mini SVG route preview (start/end markers)
  - **Green corridor badge** when AQI scoring backend returns `is_green_corridor: true`
  - Route-level AQI score with source & timestamp
- **Loading states** + inline error handling

### Green Corridor Classification
- Only routes with a configured AQI scoring backend (`VITE_ROUTE_AQI_SCORE_URL`) get classified
- Classification is **route-level** (not inferred from geometry or speed)
- Green corridors get:
  - Green border (`#9acaaa`)
  - Badge: "Green corridor" in `#218653`
  - Route preview line in healthy green `#218653` (vs standard `#2878E5`)
- Without scoring: "Route-level AQI score unavailable" — no assumptions made

### AWS Configuration
```bash
# frontend/.env.local
VITE_AWS_LOCATION_API_KEY=your_key
VITE_AWS_REGION=us-east-1          # optional, defaults to us-east-1
VITE_ROUTE_AQI_SCORE_URL=https://...  # optional, enables green corridor classification
```

### Custom Cursor Effect
- Smooth 12% easing cursor ring (`CursorEffect.tsx`)
- Interactive state: grows when hovering clickable elements
- Portal-rendered to `<body>` for no clipping
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`

## Files Changed

**New**:
- `src/pages/RoutePlannerPage.tsx` — complete route planner UI
- `src/services/locationRoutes.ts` — Amazon Location v2 client + AQI scoring
- `src/components/CursorEffect.tsx` — custom cursor ring

**Updated**:
- `src/app/router.tsx` — add `/routes` route
- `src/components/layout/SiteLayout.tsx` — add "Clean Routes" nav item
- `src/index.css` — route planner card styles, cursor effect styles
- `src/vite.config.ts` — minor config updates
- `src/.env.example` — document new env vars
- `src/README.md` — updated with route planner docs

## Testing

```bash
npm run build   # ? passes
npm run lint    # ? zero errors
```

## Notes for Reviewers
- **No breaking changes** to existing pages or API contracts
- Amazon Location calls are **direct from browser** (CORS-enabled) — no proxy needed
- Route scoring is **optional** — app works fully without `VITE_ROUTE_AQI_SCORE_URL`
- Types are strict: `CalculateRoutesResponse` matches AWS v2 schema exactly
- Error messages guide users to configure missing env vars
- Cursor effect is lightweight (~3KB gzipped) and tree-shakeable
